visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and glasses is speaking directly to the camera while holding a small black wireless microphone. She is wearing a cream-colored sweater and a pearl necklace. The background is a clean clinic office with a bouquet of flowers and a luxury bag on a shelf. (2) The scene transitions to a split-screen view showing medical professionals performing laser treatments on a patient's face; protective eyewear is worn by both. (3) The speaker returns, gesturing with her hands as she explains skin conditions. (4) Close-up shots of skin with dark melasma patches are shown as visual evidence. (5) An animation illustrates skin layers and the movement of dark pigment cells (melanocytes) within the epidermis. (6) The speaker reappears, holding a small picture of a white cat to emphasize a point. (7) High-contrast close-up photos display skin with severe depigmentation (white spots) and dark patches caused by improper treatment. (8) A black screen with white text appears, followed by a 'Before' and 'After' comparison of a patient's cheek showing significant improvement in skin tone uniformity. (9) The final scene displays the clinic's logo, contact information, and social media handles on a clean grey background with a feather motif.
